confidence_notes: I made three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for local prices. Food and drink figures from crowdsourced cost-of-living sites varied by about 2-3x, and some were dated or quoted in pesos or AUD. I set the restaurant, coffee and beer anchors near the middle of those ranges. They are adjusted upward for Ushuaia's remote, tourist-driven pricing. I found no direct restaurant price for wine by the glass. The cocktail and wine anchors are based mainly on their usual relationship to beer, with a weak cross-check from a downtown-club cocktail listing and a bottle price. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, with no live listings inspected or searched. They are highly uncertain because Ushuaia lodging is seasonal and priced in a volatile peso/dollar environment.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared against other Patagonian tourist gateways such as El Calafate and Bariloche, with Ushuaia priced at a premium to Buenos Aires for remoteness. Food anchors blend aggregated cost-of-living index figures with local tourist-restaurant price levels.
